description: Get solver volume data showing filled intents with filtering and pagination. Requires inputToken and outputToken. Optional filters: chain, solver, block range OR time range (don't mix both).

chainId.description: Filter by chain ID (e.g., 146 for Sonic)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from previous response's nextCursor

format.description: Response format: 'json' for raw data or 'markdown' for formatted text

fromBlock.description: Start block number (don't mix with since/until)

fromTs.description: Start timestamp (unix seconds). Don't mix with since/until or fromBlock/toBlock.

includeData.description: Include raw intent data in response

limit.description: Maximum number of filled intents to return (1-100)

since.description: Start time ISO format (don't mix with fromBlock/toBlock or fromTs/toTs)

solver.description: Filter by solver address (0x0...0 for default solver)

toBlock.description: End block number (don't mix with since/until)

toTs.description: End timestamp (unix seconds). Don't mix with since/until or fromBlock/toBlock.

until.description: End time ISO format (don't mix with fromBlock/toBlock or fromTs/toTs)

name: sodax_get_volume
